I need to find what Alderman Sir Cuthbert Ackroyd bought on November 1, 1956, following an April Budget that year.

In 1956, the UK introduced Premium Bonds in the April Budget. Premium Bonds were a new government savings scheme announced by Chancellor Harold Macmillan. They went on sale on November 1, 1956, and Sir Cuthbert Ackroyd, who was Lord Mayor of London at the time (1955-1956), bought the first Premium Bond.

Answer: Premium Bond

Confidence: 0.95
